method: Controlled Chrome scrolling of five actual pre-training VM screenshots in a 1280 × 360 viewport, not live Pons. Seeds fix identical page orders and top/middle/bottom starting offsets. 48 windows per arm/seed; eight-window encounter ceiling; pixel-only network and actual trusted wheel dispatch.
result: No measured improvement: all three arms produced identical aggregate outcomes.
limitations: This controlled recorded-image integration benchmark does not establish improvement on live Pons.
The learned component is a software retry budget, not neural plasticity.
No tuning on held-out outcomes; all trials and exact neural traces are retained.
